olgular.tr: 13 Kasım: Türkiye ve yakınında 71 deprem kaydedildi; 1 tanesi 3 ve üzeri, en büyüğü 3,1.
olgular.en: 13 November: 71 earthquakes were recorded in and around Turkey; 1 of magnitude 3 or more, the largest 3.1.

olgular.tr: 5 Kasım: İstanbul'da bir gün boyunca hava solumak, ince toz (PM2,5) bakımından yaklaşık 0,3 sigaraya denkti.
olgular.en: 5 November: breathing Istanbul's air for a day was roughly equal to 0.3 cigarettes in fine particles (PM2.5).

olgular.tr: İstanbul'un 10 barajında su kaplı alan, uydudan ölçülen en dolu hâlinin %86'i (alan, hacim değil).
olgular.en: The water-covered area of Istanbul's 10 reservoirs is 86% of their fullest, measured by satellite (area, not volume).

olgular.tr: 11 Kasım: Türkiye kıyılarında deniz suyu, 1991–2020 ortalamasına göre 0,3 °C daha sıcak; 41 noktanın 31 tanesi normalden sıcak.
olgular.en: 11 November: sea water along Turkey's coasts was 0.3 °C warmer than the 1991–2020 average; 31 of 41 points were warmer than normal.

olgular.tr: 12 Kasım: Türkçe Vikipedi'de birdenbire en çok "Türkiye" okundu: 31.188 kez, olağan gününün yaklaşık 6 katı.
olgular.en: 12 November: the article that suddenly drew the most readers on Turkish Wikipedia was "Türkiye": 31,188 views, about 6 times its usual day.

tr.metin: 13 Kasım: Türkiye ve yakınında 71 deprem kaydedildi; 1 tanesi 3 ve üzeri, en büyüğü 3,1. 5 Kasım: İstanbul'da bir gün boyunca hava solumak, ince toz (PM2,5) bakımından yaklaşık 0,3 sigaraya denkti. en.metin: 13 November: 71 earthquakes were recorded in and around Turkey; 1 of magnitude 3 or more, the largest 3.1. 5 November: breathing Istanbul's air for a day was roughly equal to 0.3 cigarettes in fine particles (PM2.5). The water-covered area of Istanbul's 10 reservoirs is 86% of their fullest, measured by satellite (area, not volume). 11 November: sea water along Turkey's coasts was 0.3 °C warmer than the 1991–2020 average; 31 of 41 points were warmer than normal. 12 November: the article that suddenly drew the most readers on Turkish Wikipedia was "Türkiye": 31,188 views, about 6 times its usual day.
